verdict.rationale: Sierra documents multilingual voice capability: its voice agent speaks over 55 languages, and Voice Personas run on models tuned across 59 languages / 60+ locales. That covers the multilingual half of the story, but only for voice, and nothing shows the agent answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-lingual grounding on English-only knowledge content, documented multilingual support for chat/email/SMS channels, independent or hands-on corroboration of language quality.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English
